name: Lemon Grass Tea
ingredients: 1 teaspoon loose leaf black tea or tea bag
instructions: 1. Bring water to a boil in a saucepan. 2. Add the bruised lemongrass stalks, crushed ginger, cloves, and cinnamon stick. 3. Reduce the heat and simmer for 5-7 minutes until the aroma is strong. 4. Add the tea leaves and let it steep for 1-2 minutes. 5. Strain the liquid into cups and stir in the palm jaggery or honey to taste. 6. Serve hot.
description: Lemon Grass Tea is a staple in Puducherry, reflecting the region's unique blend of French influence and South Indian herbal medicine. It is frequently served in the local 'kapi' (coffee) culture as a soothing alternative, celebrated for its refreshing citrus notes and health benefits.
